name: social-media
description: Use this skill when a design agent needs to create social media graphics: Instagram carousels and single posts, story/reel covers, birthday, anniversary, welcome, or milestone celebration cards, quote cards, product announcements, event invites, stat posts, X/LinkedIn/Facebook post images, YouTube thumbnails, profile banners, or OG share cards. It teaches the backdrop-first method — generate a small set of reusable image backdrops, then compose every asset as a pixel-exact Canvas artifact with all text in HTML — plus exact platform dimensions, artifact planning (one presentation artifact per slide set, one web_page per single asset), seven style directions, per-genre recipes with image budgets, and an image gate for deciding when an asset needs no generated images at all.
human_description: Design on-brand social media graphics: carousels, celebration cards, announcements, and more.
